weaknesses: The long elevations use closely repeated full-height glazing, reading more like an office rhythm than the approved concept’s sparse, simple blue openings.
The rendered hip roof has a comparatively tall, emphatic ridge; the reference reads as a broader, lower roof plane with deep eaves.
The reference’s paved sitting area is directly integrated with the house, whereas the visible terrace pads read as small detached slabs; exact hidden-side relationships remain uncertain.
review.improvement: Replace the main wing’s procedural long-elevation glazing with a sparse, asymmetrical set of individual openings, retaining generous blank warm wall between them and a larger simple blue opening at the visible end, to match the reference’s residential facade rhythm.
